highlights.description: Major CLI enhancement with password change, output formats, search, and import/export

added.description: Password change command (`passwd`) with automatic secret re-encryption
Output format support (`--format`) for text, JSON, YAML, and shell-sourceable output
Field extraction (`--field`) to retrieve specific fields from secrets
Search command with glob and regex pattern matching
Batch export command to export secrets as JSON
Batch import command with merge mode to skip existing secrets
List metadata flag (`--metadata`) to show timestamps and full tags
Expiry warnings for secrets approaching or past expiration
User configuration file support (`~/.omnivault/config.json`)
Flag parsing infrastructure for consistent CLI argument handling
Daemon endpoints: `/password`, `/search`, `/export`, `/import`
Integration tests for password change, search, and import/export

changed.description: Add `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` v3.0.1 for YAML output support

highlights.description: Provider registry pattern with VaultFromURI for automatic vault creation from URIs

added.description: Provider registry with `RegisterProvider`/`UnregisterProvider` for scheme-based provider factories
`VaultFromURI` function to create vaults from URI strings (e.g., `file:///path`, `env://PREFIX_`)
`RegisteredSchemes` function to query all registered URI schemes
Built-in factories for `memory://`, `file://`, and `env://` schemes
Support for external providers to self-register via `init()` imports
PlexusOne unified navigation and theme for MkDocs

highlights.description: Module path migrated from agentplexus to plexusone organization

changed.description: All internal imports updated to use new module path
Documentation URLs updated to plexusone organization

highlights.description: Cross-platform daemon code refactored to use oscompat library

changed.description: Replace platform-specific daemon code with `github.com/grokify/oscompat` library

highlights.description: Full-featured CLI tool for local secret management
AES-256-GCM encryption with Argon2id key derivation
Daemon architecture with cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows)

added.description: CLI tool (`cmd/omnivault`) for local secret management
Encrypted local store with AES-256-GCM encryption (`internal/store`)
Argon2id key derivation with OWASP-recommended parameters
Daemon server with Unix socket IPC (`internal/daemon`)
Daemon client library for IPC (`internal/client`)
Platform-specific path configuration (`internal/config`)
Auto-lock with configurable inactivity timeout (default: 15 minutes)
Master password change with automatic re-encryption
CLI commands: `init`, `unlock`, `lock`, `status`, `get`, `set`, `list`, `delete`
Daemon commands: `daemon start`, `daemon stop`, `daemon status`, `daemon run`
Secure password input without terminal echo
Integration tests for daemon and encrypted store
Windows daemon support via TCP on localhost (`127.0.0.1:19839`)
Cross-platform IPC: Unix socket on macOS/Linux, TCP on Windows

security.description: Secrets encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM
Master password never stored, only used for key derivation
Constant-time password verification to prevent timing attacks
Keys zeroed from memory on vault lock

highlights.description: Unified Go library for secret management across multiple providers
Extensible provider architecture with zero external dependencies
URI-based secret resolution for multi-provider environments

added.description: Core `vault.Vault` interface for secret management
Built-in providers: environment variables, file-based, in-memory
URI-based secret resolution with `Resolver`
Client API with `Get`, `Set`, `Delete`, `List`, `Exists` operations
Extensible provider architecture for external modules
Secret metadata support with tags and timestamps
Multi-field secrets support
